environment.description: Terraform provider deployed as a sidecar in a Kubernetes pod, exposed via a ClusterIP Service on port 8443. The service is accessible from any pod in the cluster namespace. No ingress controller or TLS termination is configured; traffic reaches the provider API directly over plaintext HTTP within the cluster network. IMDS v1 is enabled on the underlying EC2 nodes (instance metadata accessible at 169.254.169.254 without token).
